# Magic Studio

Use `magic-tauri` for the desktop app (`bun run tauri dev` in `apps/magic`). Discover operations
with `magic-cli --help` and `magic-cli commands`. Ask when the goal or a choice is unclear.
For coding, follow [CLAUDE.md](../CLAUDE.md) and [architecture](../docs/architecture.md).
Consult [the command contract](../apps/magic/MAGIC.md) and
[the control protocol](../docs/control-protocol.md) when driving a live window.
